text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the Tenno Sho (Spring),
and the Takarazuka Kinen.

What was bestowed upon Tokai Teio
for winning every single race was—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Spring Senior Triple Crown Umamusume!
Congratulations on achieving it, me!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem♪
You can praise me even more, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I achieved a legendary feat
that not even Prez has pulled off yet♪
choice_data_list: We'll save that for the celebration afterwards.
We'll save that for the celebration afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's get them to really splurge on us♪
Alright, right away—
Teio-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on achieving
the Spring Senior Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Kita-chan~!
You came to celebrate with me, didn't you♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Of course!
I mean, my idol, Teio-san, just made history!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd win every single one...!
You're reallllly, truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks♪ Since you're here,
make sure you give Kita-chan a grand celebration too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? In a big way?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Wait—a family restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Trainer said they'd treat me to a feast
to celebrate the legendary victory♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're thinking, "For a legendary celebration,
this is kinda lame..." aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no!
I didn't say it was 'pathetic'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's just, I feel like Teio-san would get way more hyped up in a big, dramatic way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're so honest~.
Well, it definitely does feel a bit lonely, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But you see, I was the one
who said a family restaurant was fine.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, why is that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because that's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
An "average" runner can't win the Spring Senior Triple Crown.
It's an honor reserved only for the absolute strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well then—if it's the strong, super-cool
'Tokai Teio,' of course she'll take it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So today, this is more than enough!
The rest will be my reward once everything's all done~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get even stronger from here on out.
You can't be satisfied just yet, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: S-So k-kewl...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I want to do amazing things just like Teio-san someday too!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, do your best♪
Well, enough chatting, let's start the celebration~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um! I tend to eat quite a lot, is that alright with you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's all good, it's all good~! 
I'm gonna order the biggest, most awesome thing on the menu anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, then I won't hold back...
First, an extra-large rib roast, an extra-large cider, and—
"And so, Tokai Teio became the Spring Senior Triple Crown Umamusume. What great feat will she accomplish next...? I can't wait to see!"
